---
- name: Render the ClusterIssuer manifest
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: cluster-issuer.yaml.j2
    dest: /tmp/kestrel-cluster-issuer.yaml
    mode: "0644"

- name: Apply the ClusterIssuer
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    src: /tmp/kestrel-cluster-issuer.yaml

---
# Defaults for ocp4_workload_kestrel_ingress.
kestrel_ingress_issuer_name: kestrel-letsencrypt
kestrel_ingress_acme_server: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
kestrel_ingress_acme_email: kestrel-lab-admins@example.com

# ACME solver for the ClusterIssuer.
kestrel_ingress_acme_solver: route53-delegated
kestrel_ingress_aws_region: us-east-1
kestrel_ingress_router_class: openshift-default

# kestrel_ingress_dns_zone has no default. The template reads it only when
# kestrel_ingress_acme_solver is route53-delegated.
